key_insight: Read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device data raises quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for standard passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of solar-cell measurements require structured experimental records, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers.
Equip an open 14B model with read-only SQL access on a single 24 GB GPU.
evidence_signal: SQL-enabled accuracy reaches 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature, while zero-shot accuracy ranges from 1.6% to 6.5%.
watch_item: Structured-table extraction and validation remain implementation requirements, and roughly half of benchmark questions are still answered incorrectly.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
